alternative_explanation_under_test: the lag predictive information reported in docs/7_AGI/25 (AML32 GCaMP, 7/7 PASS at h=1 and h=6) is an artifact of calcium indicator kinetics and/or preprocessing smoothing, not cell-intrinsic temporal memory
control_logic: AML18 expresses GFP, an activity-independent fluorophore, under the same imaging and preprocessing pipeline as AML32 GCaMP. If the alternative explanation is true, the identical local-memory gate should also PASS on AML18. If cell-intrinsic memory drives the AML32 result, AML18 should FAIL.

expected_direction.biological_interpretation_survives_if: AML18 panel gate FAILS at the AML32 pass criteria (memory signal absent in activity-independent fluorescence) for both horizons
expected_direction.claim_25_downgraded_if: AML18 panel gate PASSES at either horizon; then docs/7_AGI/25 is downgraded to a probable indicator/preprocessing artifact and must be reported as such
expected_direction.ambiguous_zone: partial passes below the panel threshold are reported as-is; any per-recording PASS in AML18 weakens the biological interpretation proportionally and is reported without reframing

claim_not_identified: biological mechanism, anatomical graph, CloudCell, monad, consciousness, or AGI architecture; a FAIL on AML18 does not prove mechanism, it only removes one alternative explanation
equation: xhat_i[t+h] = beta0 + g(x_i[t]) + beta1*x_i[t-1] + beta2*x_i[t-2], g=[x,x^2,x^3,tanh(x)]
model_family: identical to AML32 confirmatory gate; no parameter, feature, threshold, or exclusion change

split.selection: validation only; test is never used for transform, fit, or selection

null.policy: jointly circular-shift t-1 and t-2 columns within each train, validation, and test block; refit every null model
null.p_value: (1 + number(null median delta >= observed median delta)) / 20

panel_gate.recording_count: N = number of AML18_moving recordings loadable by the unmodified loader; unknown at lock time
panel_gate.min_recordings_passed_per_horizon: ceil(N * 5/7), the same pass ratio required of AML32 (5 of 7)
panel_gate.pass_semantics: PASS here means memory signal detected in GFP; per expected_direction this is evidence AGAINST the biological interpretation of docs/7_AGI/25

confirmatory_panel.sha256_source: OSF API osfstorage metadata (api.osf.io/v2/nodes/dpr3h/files/osfstorage/), fetched 2026-08-12 before download completion
confirmatory_panel.recording_ids: all recordings listed in the archive's AML18_moving_datasets.txt; if that file is absent, it is generated mechanically as: one line per directory matching BrainScanner*_MS that contains heatDataMS.mat, recording_id = directory name without the _MS suffix, sorted lexicographically, no exclusions
confirmatory_panel.loader: reality_stone.clarus.cloudcell_dynamics.load_predictioncode_recordings with default signal_field='Ratio2'; if AML18 heatDataMS.mat lacks the Ratio2 or hasPointsTime fields the run stops and the incompatibility is reported instead of adapting the loader

implementation.note: LF-normalized hash equals the hash locked in local_memory_aml32_preregistration.json; the working tree differs only by CRLF checkout, source is byte-identical modulo line endings and is not modified for this run

decision_rule: No threshold, feature, horizon, model, loader, or exclusion change is allowed after any AML18 activity score is computed. The reported outcome is whatever the gate returns, in the direction stated under expected_direction, including the unfavorable case where GFP passes.
